note: Canonical Aura roles. Aura Desktop will offer these as the role presets; the id is what the mailbox and missions carry. Free text stays allowed.

roles.label: Lead
roles.does: Splits work, writes specs, assigns, merges after the Gate.

roles.label: Builder
roles.does: Builds ONE assigned task in its own branch/worktree and hands off. Never merges.

roles.label: Gate
roles.does: Verifies a delivery against the spec (references/gate.md) and can reject it.

roles.label: QA / Tester
roles.does: Tries to break a delivery: runs the criteria and adds edge/regression/load checks, reports defects with file, command and output. Writes tests, not features.
